facts.statement: Per-fondo frente matrices live in SelectivePalletDesign.ExtraFondoBays (entry k-1 = fondo k); a missing/empty entry inherits fondo 0's Bays. Each fondo keeps its OWN frente count; the longest fondo is the width master and shorter fondos are a prefix of its grid (corner layout). DepthCount drives the number of fondos.

Medio frente = SelectiveBayDesign.Segments with Count>=2 (last tramo length = computed remainder). Legacy SelectiveBayDocument.MedioFrenteLength>0 with empty Segments is mapped to 2 tramos on load. Resolve returns null (bay drawn as a full bay although Segments exist) when a specified length <=0 or the remainder <=0 ('does not resolve').

facts.topic: L-12 half frente anchored to left post
facts.statement: The tramo overhead 2*(troquelX+inicioX) uses a single troquelX = the bay's LEFT post troquel, while bay post spacing uses both posts' troquelXs; intermediate posts take the left post's peralte. So a split bay whose two end posts have different effective peralte (PostPeraltes) is left-anchored. Matching this to the proposal's 'postes distintos' wording is an interpretation.

The medio-frente remainder depends on bay BeamLength; auto BeamLength = Frente*Count + PalletTolerance*(Count+1) unless every governing cell has BeamLengthOverride>0; PalletTolerance is a bindable (linkable) property.

A tope exists when SafetySelections holds a selection whose ElementId is a catalog variant of type TOPE (family resolved by the catalog 'type' column, first persisted variant wins). Repo catalog TOPE ids: LARGUERO_ESCALON_TOPE_DE_3, POSTE_3_1_5_8_TOPE. Config: Tope.Shared/Fondo/Saque/Frontal/OffCells (persisted TopeShared/TopeSaque/TopeFrontal/TopeFondo/TopeOffCells). LONGITUD allowance +0.25 in; spots depend on Side (None = zero spots), TopeShared and TopeFondo.

The resolver keeps a safety selection in the resolved system if Quantity>0 OR Side!=None OR any PostSide!=None, with non-blank ElementId; the payload loader drops only blank ElementIds. A tope with Side=None but Quantity>0 therefore stays in the system (zero spots) and in the payload.

LATERAL-type ids (PROTECTOR_LATERAL_BOTA_*) draw at every post whose SideForPost != None and replace botas there (frontal and planta), LONGITUD = total fondo span. Selective builders pass no adaptive sideOverride for it.

DESVIADOR OffCells are keyed by POST-column index (SelectiveGridCell.Frente holds the post column). The column index space is the sorted set of distinct run-post Xs, including medio-frente intermediate posts and corner-reach dedup; Side selects front/back aisle faces. An off-cell set not invariant under i -> P-1-i is asymmetric; index space depends on medio-frente resolution (hence on BeamLength/links).

PARRILLA (legacy alias DECK) row rule: on a full bay with no manual width/count, count = level PalletCount and is NOT clamped to what fits; decks are laid with gap=max(0,(span-count*frente)/(count+1)), i.e. stacked from the left when count*frente > span.

Pallets draw only when DrawPallets=true, using the TARIMA_GENERICA piece; full-bay rows use the design count with gap clamped at 0 (overflow stacks from the left). blocks.csv maps TARIMA_GENERICA for FRONTAL and LATERAL only (no PLANTA row).

Bindings are SelectivePalletDesignDocument.PropertyValues (key -> {Kind projectVariable|expression, VariableId, Expression}). The closed bindable catalogue is exactly selective.verticalClearance and selective.palletTolerance; effective values overwrite the domain fields before resolving. Unknown kinds are rejected by the store. Binding promotes SchemaVersion to 2.0 and it never goes back down.

VerticalClearance feeds the first clear and every level separation unless that level has ClearOverride>0; bay height derives from the top level unless HeightOverride>0; post height = tallest adjacent bay unless a custom cabecera with Height>0 exists.

Register lives in NOD entry RACKCAD_PROJECT. Absent -> empty document, accredited Usable; PresentButUnreadable/IncompatibleMajor -> NotReadable; a duplicated VariableId -> AmbiguousIdentity. The effective-design resolver requires a registry even with no bindings.

Only two Selective DTOs declare [JsonExtensionData]: SelectivePalletDesignDocument (top level, preserved by WithDesign) and SelectivePropertyValueDocument. Nested DTOs (SelectiveBayDocument, SelectiveCellDocument, SelectiveSegmentDocument, SafetySelectionDocument, GridCellDocument, PostSideDocument...) declare none, so unknown nested members are not carried (System.Text.Json default skip).

Selective has no wrapper: the envelope Design string is the SelectivePalletDesignStore JSON directly. Exterior unknown keys go to RackEmbedDocument.ExtensionData; CustomProperties is an opaque raw member omitted when null.

Both stores read with PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=true (case-variant duplicate keys collide). Selective store adds JsonStringEnumConverter (accepts integer enum values, relevant to embedded RackFrameProjectDocument enums in PostCabeceras). DimensionViews is cast raw without validation (defined bits 1,2,4); Dimensions out of range -> None; SafetySide out of range -> Both; BotaPlacement guarded by Enum.IsDefined.

The Selective store has no retired-member modifier (unlike RackProjectStore's Cantilever punch-margin drop); HighEndBeamPeralte exists only in Push Back types. Selective legacy-read members still declared: MedioFrenteLength, nullable DepthCount/DrawBasePlate/AnnotationScale/Dimensions, FloorBeamRiseOverride=null (legacy, materialized at load). Which Selective members (if any) are RM-1..RM-3/RM-7 cannot be determined from permitted sources.

Selective view decode: lateral needs Section>=0; planta ignores Section (coerced if != -1); frontal Section<0 coerced to fondo 0; empty/unknown View coerced to frontal. Canonical encode: frontal Section=fondo k, planta via whole-view encode. RACKEDITAR marks a frontal whose fondo no longer exists as VariantNotPresent (phantom). Views of a rack are found by GUID.

RackCad creates the outer definition with Origin=(0,0,0) and inserts a default BlockReference whose jig only sets Position (scale 1, rotation 0, default normal). Neutral facts exist: IsUniformScale, IsNegativeZ, NormalIsWorldZ, ReferenceBasisIsReflectionXY, DefinitionOrigin captured from BlockTableRecord.Origin. At this commit the classifier/capture adapter have no production caller (tests only).

Envelope scan skips anonymous, layout and xref definitions (an anonymous rack definition is not found at all). No Plugin code sets Annotative; IsDynamicBlock is only tested on nested piece references. No Application fact type for 'source is dynamic/annotative' was found.

The envelope is written into the DEFINITION's extension dictionary (Xrecord key RACKCAD_SELECTIVE); all seen callers pass definition ids and the scan reads from the BlockTableRecord. RackCad code writes no XData or extension dictionary on the outer reference (the RackBlockData summary says 'block reference', but call sites pass definitions).

Nested piece references get only Position, Rotation, ScaleFactors (+/-1 for mirror) and dynamic parameters (LONGITUD/PERALTE etc.); no layer/color/linetype is assigned. Annotations become DBText on layer RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES; cotas become RotatedDimension on RACKCAD_COTAS with DIMVAR overrides unless a named DimensionStyle exists. Annotations are gated by NumberFronts/NumberLevels/DrawRackName; cotas by Dimensions/DimensionViews (None always wins).

EnsureForPlan/EnsureBlocks import only missing definitions from the configured library and return 0 silently if the library file or a block is absent; the drawer then skips that piece and records it as missing. Library path = BlockLibraryLocator.ResolvePath.

facts.topic: Extra piece families from design fields
facts.statement: DepthCount>=2 adds planta separadores; DrawBasePlate adds base plates (frontal and planta groups); PostCabeceras/ExtraFondoPostCabeceras give custom per-post frames (own planta group, own height/plate in frontal); medio frente adds intermediate posts/frames.
A bay with no levels (BeamLength 0) is an empty frente; the resolver replaces the master width at that index with the widest real bay among fondos. Not one of the listed L-rows (advisory only).

Whether an ElementId is a tope/lateral/desviador/parrilla is decided by the effective catalog's type column (case-insensitive, DECK=PARRILLA), not by the payload; the repo seguridad.csv is only the shipped catalog.

Safety-family membership depends on the effective catalog's type column. The repo seguridad.csv may differ from a user's configured or shared catalog.
No AutoCAD run and no tests were executed. System.Text.Json skipping unmapped nested members is default library behavior, inferred and not exercised here.
The source-transform classifier (I-59 facts) has no production caller at 3375aadb. How RACKMIRROR will consume these facts is not in code.
Whether CustomProperties is on the proposal's exterior carrier allowlist, and whether lateral sibling views count as 'admissible' for X-15, is not stated in the sections read.
